Question: Francesca uses \(100\) grams of lemon juice, \(100\) grams of sugar, and \(400\) grams of water to make lemonade. There are \(25\) calories in \(100\) grams of lemon juice and \(386\) calories in \(100\) grams of sugar. Water contains no calories. How many calories are in \(200\) grams of her lemonade?
